name: Metal Weight Calculator
description: Universal metal weight calculator supporting steel, stainless, aluminum, copper, brass, bronze, titanium, and more.

seo.title: Metal Weight Calculator - All Metals
seo.description: Calculate metal weight for any shape and material including steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, brass, titanium, and nickel alloys.

formula.explanation: Universal formula: Weight = Volume × Density. Select from 15+ metals with pre-loaded density values.

content.introduction: Universal metal weight calculator supporting 25+ metals and alloys. Select your material from the dropdown and enter dimensions to get weight.

example.description: A 1000×500×10mm carbon steel plate weighs 39.25 kg.

faq.a: Carbon steel, stainless 304/316, aluminum, copper, brass, bronze, titanium, cast iron, nickel, lead, zinc, HDPE, PVC, glass, and various woods.
The calculator uses standard published density values. Actual weights may vary slightly due to alloy composition and manufacturing tolerances.
